title: goal: Governed factory M2: safe dark running at L1 and L2
body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone m2).

## Job

When unattended agent work starts, I want an independent verifier, a cross-family reviewer and an egress allowlist around every PR, so I can run the factory for days without a containment escape.

## Outcome

- The pinned verifier runs as three hosted jobs (secretless candidate job, credentialed policy job that never runs candidate code and posts the required check, credential-free holdout job) against the separate holdouts repository (M2-1, M2-2).
- The reviewer lane runs in its own sandbox from the other model family and its verdict is posted as a reviewer-App PR review that job B checks (M2-3).
- The daily quota window, the egress allowlist and the soak harness exist; the vendor terms are re-checked and dated (M2-5, M2-6, M2-8, M2-9).
- The soak passes: 48 to 72 active hours, about 20 issues, zero containment escapes; a seeded vacuous test and a seeded defect are caught; the builder token cannot read the holdouts.
- The OpenRig trim issues are built and merged by the factory, and `pnpm validate:release` passes after them (M2-11).
- The week-0 gate re-run passes. The WSL2 substrate exists only if the `sbx` spike failed (M2-7).

## Release intent

No publication. The author still merges every PR.

## Split judgment

Each work item in this milestone of the design is one focused PR with a declared scope; items that require each other stay one PR. The milestone's re-verification item (where it has one) lands first and fixes the exact file list. Shipping order follows the design's table.
